author: Jamie Valdez
text: Brazos Septic provides fast, reliable, and friendly service. Their pricing is competitive and often lower than other providers in the area. They arrive on time, communicate clearly throughout the process, and make the entire experience smooth and professional.

author: Patrick Maxam
text:
Great company!
Responsive and always willing to help find solutions. (Also making things right, if they don’t work out initially.)
This is who I want to take care of my septic.
Just renewed my contract with them for my personal residence 👍

author: Kerstin Wright
text: Absolutely outstanding service! From the moment I reached out, the team at Brazos Septic was friendly, attentive, and professional. Every question is always answered thoroughly, and they go above and beyond to ensure my experience was smooth and stress-free. It’s rare to find a company that genuinely cares about its customers, Dawn, Jacob and Cody exceeded my expectations. Highly recommend!!

author: Jeff Hatton
text: Jacob and his team bring incredible service and the utmost competence. We have been well served by Brazos Septic over the years.

author: Shannon Zappa
text: Brazos Septic is amazing. Anytime we’ve had an issue or question they have been so helpful, even after hours!! I can’t recommend them enough.
